## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T637 (two fascicles, alt. title 無極寶三昧經) is the Eastern Jin parallel of [T636](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0273), translated by [Gītamitra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%87%E5%A4%9A%E8%9C%9C). The two texts are independent Chinese versions of the same Indic *samādhi*-sūtra concerning the *bǎorúlái* / *wújíbǎo* "treasure" samādhi.

**Abstract**

[祇多蜜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%87%E5%A4%9A%E8%9C%9C) (Gītamitra) was an Eastern Jin translator of obscure dates; the *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145) lists him among the translators active in Jiànkāng. He is credited with around 25 short Mahāyāna translations, mostly *samādhi* and *dhāraṇī* texts. T637 is unanimously attributed to him in the canonical bibliographies. Date bracket follows the Eastern Jin span (317–420), the only horizon to which his activity can be confidently assigned; it is not possible to refine further. The text is closely paralleled by [T636](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0273) (Dharmarakṣa's *Wújí bǎo sānmèi jīng*); both render the same Indic *sūtra* through different Chinese hands. Comparative study of the two has been a standard exercise in early Chinese Buddhist philology.
